plan.title: Live RFQ Shared With participation summary

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on the buyer's Responses tab, as required for prepared-state cases.
Open Shared With from the RFQ Settings menu and leave the Participation Summary drawer open.
Assert that the Shared With drawer opens with the expected title.
Verify the drawer reports one invited participant.
Verify the drawer reports zero participants who have seen the event.
Verify the actual prepared state has no submitted bid; this differs from the test's stated expected count of one.
Verify the drawer reports zero participants in the not-placed category for this prepared state.
Verify the unregistered POC bids section is present.
Verify the drawer exposes the Notify action without pressing it.
